categories.main_business_segments: Geovis Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in aerospace information technology, commercial aerospace, and low-altitude economy sectors. Its main business includes software sales and data services, technical development and services, specialized equipment manufacturing, and system integration. The company focuses on satellite-based space information services, ground-based capabilities, and cloud-based aerospace information platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as cross-scale remote sensing large models, multi-source fusion digital twin reconstruction, intelligent agent technology for digital earth applications, 3D grid-based low-altitude airspace digital construction, large-scale aircraft low-altitude safety real-time computing, integrated satellite-ground intelligent measurement and control, and supercomputing data factory technology. It employs cloud computing, AI, high-performance computing, and big data for aerospace data processing and service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, special sectors, enterprises, and public users. The company serves industries such as water conservancy, public safety, smart cities, natural resources, energy, finance, meteorology, and aerospace. It also targets commercial aerospace and low-altitude economy markets, providing solutions for satellite constellation operations, meteorological services, and low-altitude airspace management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant business in regions including North China, East China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, South China, and Northeast China. It has subsidiaries and operations in major cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Hefei, Xi'an, Nanjing, Qingdao, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Geovis Technology operates across the aerospace information supply chain, including upstream satellite constellation operations, midstream satellite measurement and control, and downstream satellite data processing and application services. It also integrates cloud computing and AI capabilities, positioning itself as a comprehensive aerospace information service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes strategic expansion into the full commercial aerospace industry chain, enhancing satellite data processing, satellite measurement and control, and aerospace electronic systems. It focuses on building a cloud-based aerospace information ecosystem, advancing AI-driven aerospace data services, and developing low-altitude airspace management technologies. R&D priorities include large-scale remote sensing models, digital twin technologies, intelligent computing platforms, and integrated satellite-ground control systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through software sales and data services, technical development and services, specialized equipment sales, and system integration. The company also adopts cloud service subscription models, standardized product direct sales, and customized value-added services to monetize its aerospace information capabilities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Geovis Technology is positioned as a leading innovator and integrator in China's aerospace information technology sector. It holds a strong market position in commercial aerospace and low-altitude economy industries, recognized as a top enterprise in geographic information and aerospace data services. The company collaborates with national research institutes and industry partners to maintain technological leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.26 billion, representing a 29.49% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 352 million, a 2.67% increase. Total assets grew by 37.49% to RMB 8.29 billion, reflecting significant scale expansion and strategic acquisitions. The company maintains a robust growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Geovis Technology differentiates itself through its comprehensive aerospace information capabilities, integrating satellite data, cloud computing, AI, and digital earth technologies. It offers proprietary intelligent measurement and control systems, large-scale remote sensing models, and a cloud-based aerospace information platform that supports diverse industry applications. The company emphasizes innovation, ecosystem building, and high-quality data services to empower government, enterprise, and public users with precise, real-time aerospace information.
